collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-32  -  THE LEADER WHO LISTENED SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A village leader proposes changing the work schedule, but several villagers worry about their family responsibilities.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A village leader proposes changing the work schedule, but several villagers worry that the new hours will interfere with family responsibilities.

choices.label: Invite Those Affected to Explain Their Concerns.
Try the Schedule for a Short Period.
Keep the Existing Schedule Until a Better Plan Is Ready.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The concerns conflict, and the group agrees that further discussion is necessary.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The trial reveals which tasks benefit from the change.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Several families struggle with the arrangement, and the leader restores the earlier hours.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A quiet farmer suggests a compromise that accommodates most households.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: No single proposal satisfies everyone, but the discussion clarifies the tradeoffs.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The villagers appreciate being given time to consider the change.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Some work remains inconvenient, and the leader acknowledges the unresolved problem.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The leader discovers a practical adjustment that had not been considered.
